## The finding

A **file** field on a `FormView` renders as a plain **text box**. The `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` routes go through `FormPage` — ⭐ this repo's **second** form renderer — whose hand-rolled input switch has no `file` arm, so the field falls through to the default text input.

## ⭐ Why this is the same card as one that already landed

This is the identical shape as objectui#10129, which landed today as PR objectui#10158: a field type whose control exists and works on one renderer, falling through to a bare text input on another because that renderer re-spells the switch instead of asking the shared resolver.

⚠️ **Four cards this shift had that root cause.** ⇒ the question worth answering alongside the fix is not just 「add a `file` arm」 but **why there are two input switches at all**, and whether `FormPage`'s can be routed through the same resolver the record form uses. ⛔ Adding one arm fixes `file` and leaves the next field type to be discovered the same way.

## Step 1

Enumerate, uncapped, which field types `FormPage`'s switch handles versus what the shared resolver handles. ⭐ That list is the real size of this card, and it is ⛔ not knowable from the `file` symptom alone.

## Dedupe words

`FormPage FormView file text input second renderer` · `hand-rolled input switch no file arm` · `/f/:slug /forms/:name field type fallthrough` · `objectui#10158 same shape other renderer`
